records.name: Riau
records.summary:
Riau's audited sources are national-level: a 2022 wire report, retrieved only as a fetch-time summary, of police denying violence in the death in Bali custody of a transgender rights activist arrested on drug charges; and an August 2026 feature recording President Prabowo's October 2025 decree listing "the promotion of LGBTQ+ culture" among non-military security threats alongside terrorism and narcotics, and a wave of vigilante mob attacks on trans women during 14-16 July 2026, concentrated in West Java's Bogor, as the government moved to codify anti-LGBT attitudes into law.

No Riau-specific statute, raid, protection or service record appears in the material. The province is assessed under those national conditions: identity is not criminalised in most of the republic, but the official posture now treats visibility as a security threat and mob violence recurs with limited accountability; nothing documents a Riau divergence either way.

records.name: East Nusa Tenggara
records.summary: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score.
